name: MDI Phrase Finder & Hidden AI Copy Detection
author: Medium Interactive

sections.description:
MDI Phrase Finder & Hidden AI Copy Detection is a powerful search-and-audit tool that scans your entire WordPress site for any phrase you need to find — instantly, across every page, post, and custom post type, including content built with Elementor.

Hidden AI Copy Detection

Its standout feature is hidden AI copy detection. When you paste content directly from AI chat tools like ChatGPT or Claude into WordPress, invisible HTML code often comes along with it — attributes and CSS classes such as data-testid, conversation-turn, font-claude-response-body, and standard-markdown. You can’t see this code on the page, but search engines can. It acts as a fingerprint of unedited, machine-generated content and can quietly undermine your SEO.

Fast Phrase Finder ships with a verified, regularly updated list of these ChatGPT and Claude signatures and flags every page where they’re hiding — including inside Elementor’s data, where most scanners never look.

Far more than AI cleanup

Because it searches for any exact text you specify, it solves a whole range of everyday content problems:

  • Misspellings — find every instance of a typo a team member keeps making (for example, “trafic” or “Search Engineer Optimization”).
  • Brand standardization — locate every place a name appears the wrong way (“Stag Rentals”) so you can switch it to the correct form (“Stag Power Rentals”).
  • Brand or content removal — track down an old brand, a competitor mention, or any phrase that should no longer appear anywhere on your site.
  • Security spot-checks — search for suspicious words (like “casino”) that can signal a hacked page or spam injection.
  • Compliance — quickly confirm a restricted phrase isn’t published anywhere.

Three report formats

Results are presented in three clear formats so you can work the way you prefer:

  • By Page — one row per affected page with all phrases combined, ideal for a clean-up checklist.
  • By Phrase — shows how widespread each phrase is across the site.
  • Individual Matches — a precise, occurrence-level audit.

Every phrase is click-to-copy, filterable, and exportable to CSV.

Built for real workflows

  • Background batch scanning so large sites never time out.
  • Scheduled daily or weekly scans.
  • One-click rescan on any individual page after you fix it.
  • Full support for drafts, private pages, and custom post types.
  • A built-in checklist to enable or disable any detection phrase.
  • A custom phrases box to add your own in seconds.

Whether you’re an SEO professional auditing client sites, an agency standardizing brand language, or a site owner making sure AI-assisted content is clean before it’s indexed, MDI Phrase Finder & Hidden AI Copy Detection gives you a fast, thorough, and reliable way to find exactly what you’re looking for.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it directly through Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Phrase Finder → Settings in the admin menu.
  4. Review the built-in phrase checklist, optionally add your own phrases under Custom Phrases, and set your scan options (drafts, private pages, Elementor/meta scanning, case sensitivity, exact match, batch size).
  5. Click Save Settings.
  6. Click Run Scan Now to perform your first scan, or set up a recurring scan under Scheduled Scans.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin modify or delete any content on my site?

No. Fast Phrase Finder only reads and reports. It never edits, removes, or rewrites your posts, pages, or post meta — you decide what to change and where.

Does it scan Elementor content?

Yes. When the Elementor/Meta option is enabled, the scanner reads _elementor_data and other post meta in addition to the standard content, title, and excerpt fields, so phrases hidden inside Elementor’s stored data are still caught.

Will scanning slow down my site or time out on a large site?

Scans run in background batches through the admin area, with a configurable batch size, so large sites can complete a full scan without hitting PHP timeout limits.

Can I add my own phrases to search for?

Yes. Use the Custom Phrases box on the Settings screen — one phrase per line — in addition to the built-in checklist of AI artifact signatures.

Does it scan drafts and private pages?

Only if you enable those options on the Settings screen. By default, only published content is scanned.

Can I schedule scans to run automatically?

Yes. Choose Daily (midnight or a custom time) or Weekly under Scheduled Scans on the Settings screen.
